overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Main corrections: (1) Removed non-NLG models from Q1 (BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa are discriminative classifiers, not generation models), (2) Normalized metric names to base forms, (3) Removed placeholder values from Q3. The paper focuses on commonsense reasoning through conceptualization and generation, with solid evaluation using both automatic metrics and human judgments.
